requirements.title: Execution integrity
requirements.goal: Preserve current repo authority, narrow scope, isolated assignments, reviewed evidence, and resumption without duplicate work.

requirements.title: Correct geographic identity
requirements.goal: Supported names/levels resolve correctly; ambiguity, unknown and out-of-scope requests never masquerade as successful geography.

requirements.title: Honest facts and coverage
requirements.goal: Facts, types, units, vintage, parent relationships and map representation agree with supported source data.

requirements.title: Useful inline answer
requirements.goal: A correct readable map answers the initial request without a second search, dashboard, or excessive interface.

requirements.title: Coherent exploration
requirements.goal: Host-supported fullscreen and return preserve compatible view/selection; parent and back have distinct meanings.

requirements.title: Point and ask
requirements.goal: Selection identifies an actual supported feature, updates bounded context, and supports an intentional named follow-up.

requirements.title: Reliable recovery
requirements.goal: Loading, refusal, retry, cancellation and stale event handling preserve the last good view without mislabelling it.

requirements.title: Accessible mobile product
requirements.goal: Touch, keyboard, screen-reader, reduced-motion and small-view flows reach the same meaningful actions.

requirements.title: Correct ChatGPT integration
requirements.goal: Current supported bridge/resources, bounded output, actual host lifecycle and refreshed-client evidence support the product.

requirements.title: Safe read-only boundaries
requirements.goal: Retired writes/providers stay unavailable; input, diagnostics, privacy and secrets handling fit actual behavior.

requirements.title: Reproducible measurable operation
requirements.goal: A clean candidate builds with pinned dependencies, tested assets, measured behavior, and identifiable artifacts.

requirements.title: Truthful discovery and release
requirements.goal: Descriptions, docs, demo, permissions, deployment, host proof and submission claims match observed scope.

requirements.title: Demonstrated usefulness
requirements.goal: Formative human testing checks comprehension, selection handoff, recovery and scope understanding without inventing participants.
